topic: Animal Body Parts and Their Functions
key_concepts: Animals have different body parts such as fins, legs, wings, tails, beaks, teeth, and claw
Fish use fins and tails to swim and catch smaller fish.
Dogs and horses use legs and feet to walk or run on land.
Birds have different beak shapes suited to their food, such as long thin beaks for nectar
Birds have different wing shapes for soaring, fast flying, or hovering.
Sharp pointed teeth cut and tear meat, while flat rounded teeth grind and crush plants.
Webbed feet help ducks swim, and long strong hindlimbs help kangaroos jump.
Long legs help animals like cheetahs run fast to catch prey.
Claws help eagles catch prey or climb.
